result.summary: VERIFY_ONLY audit of four G5-001 authority-boundary defects challenged by Codex. All four FAIL on current services/agm_gateway product: (1) untrusted budget_context can raise configured server caps and seed/reset ledger; non-finite/bool budget fields are not rejected before dispatch; (2) arbitrary injected ProviderInterface is invoked when provider_mode=fixture even if allow_real_provider=false; allow_real_provider=true alone would open non-fixture modes without a separate HITL path; (3) idempotency store keys only on request_id/gateway_request_id with no canonical fingerprint of redacted result-affecting inputs, so payload-changed ID reuse returns the prior response; (4) regression tests for these cases are absent. C1_NETWORK_GATEWAY_PATCH is sole product writer under services/agm_gateway/**.

in_scope: Record exact four failed invariants with file:line evidence
Define C1 required product fix contracts (budget authority, provider authority, idempotency fingerprint)
List concrete regression test names and pass criteria C1 must add
Preserve existing 20 gateway tests as non-regression baseline
out_of_scope: Product edits under services/agm_gateway/** (C1 sole writer)
Godot paid adapter product edits (C2 VERIFY_ONLY consumer only)
Real provider, SDK, credentials, outbound network

authority_boundary.provider_selection: HITL_REQUIRED — must remain disabled; correction must not make allow_real_provider=true sufficient alone

codex_challenges_mapped.codex_challenge: Untrusted budget_context can replace configured server caps with larger values, allowing a request to bypass both hard caps.
NaN and Infinity budget values pass comparisons and reach the provider instead of failing closed.
An arbitrary injected ProviderInterface is called when allow_real_provider is false if the request labels its mode fixture.
A reused request_id or gateway_request_id with a different payload returns the prior response because idempotency is not bound to a canonical request fingerprint.

failed_invariants.statement: Configured GatewayService.per_request_cap and session_cap are hard upper bounds. An untrusted request may only request a stricter lower cap; it cannot raise either configured cap. The server ledger is authoritative: client session_spent must not reset, reduce, or replace it. Reject booleans, negative values, NaN, ±Infinity, and other non-finite/non-numeric budget fields before provider dispatch. A rejected budget request must not call the provider or charge the ledger.

required_behavior.client_may: request a lower (stricter) per_request_cap and/or session_cap only
client_must_not: raise per_request_cap above configured server per_request_cap
raise session_cap above configured server session_cap
set or reset server ledger.session_spent via budget_context.session_spent
pass bool / non-numeric / NaN / ±Inf budget fields

recommended_effective_caps.effective_per_request_cap: min(server.per_request_cap, client_requested) when client supplies a valid finite non-negative number; else server.per_request_cap
recommended_effective_caps.effective_session_cap: min(server.session_cap, client_requested) when client supplies a valid finite non-negative number; else server.session_cap
recommended_effective_caps.session_spent: always self.ledger.session_spent; ignore or reject client session_spent as authority input (constructor-seeded ledger only)

numeric_validation.accept: finite number (int/float subclass of numbers.Real excluding bool), value >= 0
reject: non-numeric strings/objects/null where a number is required
numeric_validation.implementation_hint: Use math.isfinite after type-safe parse; never bare float(x) on untrusted input without type/isfinite guards

current_defects.evidence: per_request_cap = float(budget_context.get("per_request_cap", self.per_request_cap)); session_cap = float(budget_context.get("session_cap", self.session_cap)) — client value replaces server cap with no min() against configured hard upper bounds.
current_defects.impact: Client can send per_request_cap=1e15 / session_cap=1e15 and bypass GatewayService configured caps.

current_defects.evidence: if "session_spent" in budget_context and self.ledger.session_spent == 0.0: self.ledger = SessionBudgetLedger(session_spent=requested_spent) — untrusted request seeds/replaces server ledger when spent is zero.
current_defects.impact: Client can reset or invent session_spent, undermining session_cap accounting (and tests currently rely on this unsafe seed path).

current_defects.evidence: check_budget only rejects estimate < 0 or session_spent < 0. No math.isfinite, no bool rejection, no type guard. IEEE NaN comparisons (estimate > cap, session_spent + estimate > session_cap) evaluate False, so NaN/±Inf pass and reach provider.
current_defects.impact: NaN/Infinity (and float(True)==1.0 bool coercion via gateway float()) can pass checks.

current_defects.evidence: Bare float() on budget_context fields: float('nan'), float('inf'), float(True) succeed without policy/budget rejection path before check_budget.
current_defects.impact: Non-numeric-looking but float-coercible and non-finite values reach estimate/check path.

preserved_good_behavior: Failed pre-dispatch budget rejects do not charge ledger when check_budget raises (charge only on success path gateway.py:358)
estimate_budget returns non-negative finite estimate for normal snapshots
Existing AT-BUDGET-PER-REQUEST / AT-BUDGET-SESSION tests remain required green (must be updated if they depend on client raising caps or client ledger seed — client may still lower caps)

failed_invariants.statement: When allow_real_provider is false, an injected provider that is not an approved fixture provider must fail with a structured non-retryable policy error BEFORE any provider method is called, even when provider_mode=fixture. Do not add or call a real provider, SDK, credential, or network transport. Future real-provider enablement remains a separate HITL-approved path; allow_real_provider=true alone must NOT be sufficient for real enablement.

when_allow_real_provider_false.allowed_provider_objects: FixtureProvider (or explicit approved fixture registry membership — isinstance FixtureProvider is MVP)

must_also_require: Separate HITL-approved real provider type/allowlist (not implemented in this correction)
No automatic enablement of outbound network/SDK merely because the flag is true

G5-001 correction must still deny real transport; flag true alone must not call arbitrary injected non-fixture providers without an additional approved real-provider path (which remains out of scope / HITL)
when_allow_real_provider_true.correction_constraint: Do not implement real providers; do not make allow_real_provider=true sufficient by itself to dispatch non-fixture providers

forbidden: Calling provider.generate_decision on unapproved injection under allow_real_provider=false

current_defects.evidence: Constructor accepts any ProviderInterface (provider or FixtureProvider()). Policy gate only checks request provider_mode string against ALLOWED_PROVIDER_MODES={'fixture'}. When provider_mode is fixture/fixture_provider, execution always reaches self.provider.generate_decision via retry_policy.run with no isinstance(self.provider, FixtureProvider) (or allowlist) check.
current_defects.impact: Test double / malicious ProviderInterface subclass with label/mode fixture is invoked while allow_real_provider=false.

current_defects.evidence: if provider_mode not in ALLOWED_PROVIDER_MODES: if not self.allow_real_provider: raise ... — when allow_real_provider is true, non-fixture provider_mode is not denied and still calls self.provider (still whatever was injected).
current_defects.impact: allow_real_provider=true alone is treated as sufficient to skip mode deny without a separate HITL real-provider implementation gate.

current_defects.evidence: ProviderInterface is an unconstrained ABC; any subclass satisfies injection typing.
current_defects.impact: Type system alone does not encode fixture-only authority.

preserved_good_behavior: Default GatewayService() uses FixtureProvider and allow_real_provider=False
Non-fixture provider_mode string denied with category=policy code=provider_mode_denied when allow_real_provider=False (test_only_fixture_provider_enabled)

failed_invariants.statement: Bind request_id and gateway_request_id records to a deterministic canonical fingerprint of the validated/redacted request inputs that affect the result. An identical replay returns the stored response without redispatch or charge. Reuse of either id with a different fingerprint fails closed with a structured non-retryable conflict/policy response and no provider call (and no charge). Never include raw secrets, hidden prompts, or credential values in a fingerprint, log, error, or receipt.

store_record_shape.fingerprint: canonical hash of result-affecting redacted inputs
store_record_shape.response: safe success or terminal error envelope (no secrets)

include: redacted snapshot body (post deep deny-list strip, schema-validated)
effective budget caps used for the decision (server-authoritative effective caps)
edition / require_api_paid path inputs that affect outcome
fingerprint_material.canonicalization: Deterministic JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8) then SHA-256 hex; version the material schema (e.g. aidle_gateway_idempotency_fp_v1)

identical_replay.condition: same request_id (or gateway_request_id) AND same fingerprint
identical_replay.behavior: return stored response; provider call_count unchanged; no additional ledger charge

conflict.condition: same request_id OR same gateway_request_id AND different fingerprint

behavior.must_not: return prior response as success for different payload

required_behavior.pipeline_order_note: Fingerprint binding must run after redaction (+ snapshot validation of inputs that enter the fingerprint). Lookup that returns prior response must verify fingerprint match; mismatch is conflict, not silent replay. Prefer checking both request_id and gateway_request_id when both present and distinct.

current_defects.evidence: IdempotencyStore maps key -> response only. No fingerprint field, no put(key, fingerprint, response), no conflict detection API.
current_defects.impact: Cannot distinguish identical replay from ID reuse with different payload.

current_defects.evidence: prior = self.idempotency.get(request_id); if prior is not None: return prior — and same for gateway_request_id. No comparison of current request body to stored fingerprint.
current_defects.impact: Changed payload with reused request_id/gateway_request_id returns prior decision (Codex challenge exact).

current_defects.evidence: self.idempotency.put(request_id, response) without binding fingerprint of redacted inputs.
current_defects.impact: Store cannot enforce INV-IDEMPOTENCY-FINGERPRINT on subsequent requests.

preserved_good_behavior: Identical request_id replay currently skips second provider call (AT-IDEMPOTENCY-REPLAY) — must remain true when fingerprint matches
Deepcopy on get/put avoids shared mutable response objects
Docstring claims no secrets in store — fingerprint must uphold that

failed_invariants.statement: Adversarial regression tests proving the three product invariants must exist and pass alongside the existing 20 gateway tests.

current_defects.evidence: TestBudget only covers client-lowered caps (est*0.5) and client-seeded session_spent; no test that client-raised caps are clamped/rejected against server GatewayService(per_request_cap=..., session_cap=...).
current_defects.impact: Codex missing_evidence: No adversarial test proves server caps cannot be raised by a client.
Codex missing_evidence: No test rejects non-finite budget inputs.

current_defects.evidence: test_only_fixture_provider_enabled only denies provider_mode string 'anthropic'; still uses FixtureProvider instance. No injected non-FixtureProvider object under allow_real_provider=False.
current_defects.impact: Codex missing_evidence: No test rejects a non-fixture provider object while real-provider authority is disabled.

current_defects.evidence: test_same_request_id_no_second_provider_call only exercises identical replay; no changed-payload conflict case for request_id or gateway_request_id.
current_defects.impact: Codex missing_evidence: No test rejects idempotency-key reuse with a changed canonical request.

defects_found.title: Client budget_context can raise server hard caps
defects_found.detail: gateway.py uses client per_request_cap/session_cap via float(budget_context.get(...)) without clamping to configured GatewayService caps, so untrusted input can bypass both hard upper bounds.

defects_found.title: Client session_spent can seed/replace server ledger; non-finite/bool budget fields not rejected
defects_found.detail: When ledger.session_spent==0, client session_spent replaces the ledger. check_budget lacks isfinite/type guards; NaN/±Inf comparisons fail open; bare float() coerces True and non-finite strings.

defects_found.title: Injected non-fixture ProviderInterface is called under allow_real_provider=false when provider_mode=fixture
defects_found.detail: No object-level approval gate before generate_decision. Mode string 'fixture' authorizes whatever provider object was injected. allow_real_provider=true alone also skips mode deny without a separate HITL real-provider path.

defects_found.title: Idempotency keys not bound to canonical request fingerprint
defects_found.detail: IdempotencyStore and handle_request short-circuit return prior response by key only. Reuse of request_id or gateway_request_id with a different redacted payload incorrectly replays the prior result instead of non-retryable conflict; provider is not re-called but wrong authorization outcome is returned.

defects_found.title: Missing adversarial regression tests for the four authority cases
defects_found.detail: Existing 20 tests do not cover client-raised caps, non-finite budget inputs, non-fixture object injection, or fingerprint conflict on ID reuse.

required_fixes_for_c1.action: Implement server-owned budget authority: parse/validate budget fields (reject bool, negative, NaN, ±Inf, non-numeric) before dispatch; effective caps = min(server_cap, client_requested) when client supplies valid lower value; never let client raise caps; never let client session_spent reset/replace server ledger; rejected budget never calls provider or charges ledger.

Before any provider method call, if allow_real_provider is false, require approved fixture provider object (isinstance FixtureProvider or explicit approved set). On failure return structured non-retryable policy error. Do not implement real providers. Ensure allow_real_provider=true alone is not sufficient to enable real/non-approved providers (still deny non-approved objects / require future HITL path).

Bind request_id and gateway_request_id to canonical fingerprint of redacted/validated result-affecting inputs. Identical replay returns stored response. Different fingerprint with same id → non-retryable conflict, no provider call, no charge. Never fingerprint secrets (compute over redacted material only).
Add all result.required_tests regression cases; keep existing 20 green (adjust only if a prior test encoded the unsafe client-ledger-seed or client-raised-cap behavior as expected).

baseline.statement: Existing 20 gateway unit tests remain green after correction
